HANPASS campaign hero artwork — 2026-09-30

Created with the built-in image_gen tool. Original transparent PNGs retained.
Files: wallet.png, calendar.png, travel.png, gift.png, global.png.
Text, logo, backgrounds and buttons are drawn separately by format-workspace.js
and remain editable. The card template uses the existing HANPASS card artwork.

Prompt set
Common direction: ads-marketing; isolated premium 3D hero artwork for editable
Korean fintech advertising. Premium contemporary Korean financial advertising,
polished Cinema4D product rendering, physically believable beveled geometry,
satin ceramic, glossy acrylic and metallic gold, soft studio key light from upper
left, cool reflections and realistic ambient occlusion. Blue/white/gold palette.
Square composition, objects fully in frame, about 85% image coverage, genuine
transparent background with subtle contact shadow. No typography, letters,
numbers, logos, watermarks, UI, flat illustration or low-poly forms.

wallet.png: Large cobalt and icy blue wallet open at a three-quarter angle,
thick gold coins emerging, smooth pearlescent payment card without text,
gold clasp and two floating gold coins, unified still-life composition.

calendar.png: Periwinkle and white desktop ring calendar, slightly tilted,
embossed cobalt checkmark on a white page, four thick white rings, polished gold
notification bell hovering at upper right, two gold coins and tiny white clouds.

travel.png: White passenger airplane with cobalt fuselage accents flying toward
viewer, pale blue rounded airplane window portal, white clouds, cobalt hard-shell
suitcase at base and a small gold coin, unified composition.

gift.png: Open glossy cobalt gift box, thick silky ice-blue ribbon curling upward,
large lustrous gold coin emerging and two smaller floating coins, bold sculpture.

global.png: Translucent icy blue globe, raised white continents and luminous cobalt
meridians, sweeping polished cobalt orbital arrow, smaller white arrow and two
gold coins near base, premium international money transfer conceptual sculpture.
